title: Night Audit Standard: No-Shows on Room Reservations
content:
## When a reservation becomes a no-show

A Room Reservations reservation becomes a no-show only when the guest has not checked in by the night audit that closes the arrival date. A reservation may be marked a no-show only after the night audit following the reservation's arrival date has run without a check-in. The night audit runs at 03:00 hotel local time on the calendar day obtained by adding 1 day to the arrival date; a reservation is marked no earlier than that moment. Reservations that were cancelled, relocated or checked in are never marked.

Marking a no-show is a hotel action; guest services never marks one.

| Arrival date (hypothetical) | Night audit that closes it | Moment checked | May the reservation be marked? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 June | 21 June, 03:00 hotel local time | 21 June, 02:59 | No — the audit has not yet run |
| 20 June | 21 June, 03:00 hotel local time | 21 June, 03:00 | Yes, if no check-in was recorded |
| 20 June | 21 June, 03:00 hotel local time | any time, guest checked in on 20 June | No — checked-in reservations are never marked |

## The no-show charge

- **No longer in force.** The former clause "the no-show charge follows the plan's no-show basis and is computed exactly as the late cancellation penalty: the first-night basis is one night of room and tax and the full-stay basis is every night of the stay" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for the no-show charge.
- A no-show charge is posted only on a reservation whose status is no-show, as shown on the reservation record.
- When the plan releases the nights after the first on a no-show, those nights are released and not charged; when it does not, the whole stay is retained.
- Under the first night points basis no cash is charged: the points or Free Night Award of the first night are retained and the rest of the redemption is returned.
- Settlement follows the guarantee as for late cancellations: from the money held when the guarantee is an advance deposit or a full prepayment, otherwise to the card on file.
- A reservation carries at most one cancellation penalty or no-show charge, as its charge records show.

## Points of judgement

**A reservation cancelled before the audit runs.** It is never marked a no-show: reservations that were cancelled are never marked.

**Who records the no-show itself?** The hotel's night audit. Guest services never marks a reservation a no-show.

superseded_clauses: The no-show charge follows the plan's no_show_penalty_basis and is computed exactly as the late cancellation penalty: first_night_room_and_tax is one night of room and tax and full_stay_room_and_tax is every night of the stay.
